record.paper_title: Free Boundary Minimal Surfaces in the Unit Ball: Recent Advances and Open Questions
record.original_question: Let Σ^k be an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold of the Euclidean unit ball B^n, and let f: B^n → B^n be a conformal diffeomorphism. Is the (k−1)-dimensional volume of the boundary maximal within its conformal orbit, in the sense that |f(∂Σ)| ≤ |∂Σ| always holds?

evidence.quote: Open Question 9. Let Σ^k be an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold in B^n. Suppose f : B^n → B^n is a conformal diffeomorphism. Is it true that |f(∂Σ)| ≤ |∂Σ|?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B^n = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : |x| \le 1\}$ denote the closed Euclidean unit ball, and let $\Sigma^k \subset B^n$ be an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold of dimension $k$; that is, $\Sigma$ is a minimal $k$-dimensional immersed submanifold whose boundary $\partial\Sigma$ lies on $\partial B^n = S^{n-1}$ and meets $S^{n-1}$ orthogonally. Let $f : B^n \to B^n$ be a conformal diffeomorphism (the group of such maps coincides with the Möbius transformations of the ball). Denote by $|\cdot|$ the $(k-1)$-dimensional Hausdorff volume.

Determine whether the inequality
$$|f(\partial \Sigma)| \le |\partial \Sigma|$$
holds for every such $\Sigma$ and every conformal diffeomorphism $f : B^n \to B^n$; equivalently, whether the boundary volume of a free boundary minimal submanifold is maximal within its conformal orbit.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open question in the survey on free boundary minimal surfaces in the unit ball. A web search did not turn up any subsequent paper resolving the conformal monotonicity of boundary volume for general free boundary minimal submanifolds; related work addresses linear isoperimetric inequalities, monotonicity formulae, and widths, but not this specific conjecture. The status thus appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Free boundary minimal surfaces in the unit ball: recent advances and open questions
status_evidence.snippet: List of open questions including conformal monotonicity of boundary volume.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open question in this survey.

status_evidence.title: Linear isoperimetric inequalities for free boundary submanifolds in a geodesic ball
status_evidence.snippet: Linear isoperimetric inequalities for free boundary submanifolds; does not establish conformal monotonicity of boundary volume.
status_evidence.claim: Related results exist but do not resolve the conformal-orbit boundary volume inequality.
